rerun_rule: This manifest covers only the files as hashed at this run; the tag commit's tree must hold each of them at the sha256 recorded here. If any trigger below fires after this run and before the tag commit, the named items must be re-run, N18 last. The order runs N18 twice: "N18 (item 4) → README-NOTE re-point", then the PI's README.md pass (if not yet done) and "the preflip-script commit → N18 again → tag → push" (results/raw/2026-11-02_note-design-to-code_N1-r11-answers.md@da50cd1:60; results/raw/2026-10-28_note-design-to-code_release-block-answers.md@908a659:65-66). The README-NOTE re-point and the preflip-script commit each change a listed file (trigger 3), as does the PI's README.md pass (README.md is a named file); the second run regenerates this manifest in place, and its manifest is the one the tag commit holds.

footer_note: The block puts the note's sha256 in the note's footer (:133). A footer inside the hashed file changes that file's sha256, so the footer cannot state the hash of the file that contains it. At v2 the note carries no footer: it is frozen as posted ("v0.8 does not change again before the tag", results/raw/2026-10-28_note-design-to-code_release-block-answers.md@908a659:23), and the v0.8 sha256 and the tag commit go to POST-note, the design seat's, after the tag (:68 of the same file).
